description: Ask the admins for access to a company integration (e.g. you only have read access to pipedrive and need write). Creates or updates one open request per integration; an admin decides with decide_integration_access_request. Required: provider, access_right (read | write | manage). Optional reason (say why — the admin sees it).

provider.description: Integration to request access to, e.g. pipedrive

name: request_integration_access
